title: A corner resize that keeps proportions still snaps to guides and neighbours
goal: Since corners keep a layer's proportions by default (the user, 2026-11-01), a corner drag no longer lines its edge up with guides, the grid or nearby layers, because snapping only ever ran on free resizes. A redline user resizing a box to meet a neighbour loses the yellow guide. The dragged corner should still catch, with the other side following the proportions.
notes: Reproduced by reading and by the walk numbers: CanvasPointerDrags.swift resize branch, snapping = !aspect && !held.isFree && !centred, and aspect is now SelectionDrag.keepsProportions(handle, shift:) which is true for every corner without Shift. selection-grips-walk step 12 corner drag reports no guide. Before next-transform-modes only Shift-corner drags (rare) skipped snapping. Found by the-reworked-selection-ships-cleaner-grips-a-tag.
acceptance: A corner drag at Next defaults on an upright layer catches a guide, a grid line or a neighbour's edge on the axis that leads, and the yellow guide shows
The proportions are kept exactly while caught
Command still frees the drag of every magnet
A walk drags a corner to a neighbour's edge and claims the guide caught
